response.text: Consumer fireworks may be discharged in the City only on Victoria Day or Canada Day, or on a day covered by a special occasions fireworks discharge permit issued by the Fire Chief [2]. If weather makes the designated day impractical or unsafe, the next day before or after it becomes the designated day [2]. On Victoria Day or Canada Day, discharge is not allowed after 11:00 p.m. [2]. A permit is not needed for consumer fireworks on Victoria Day or Canada Day [1]. Discharge on any other day requires a special occasions permit, which applies only to a specified date, time and location [3]. Discharge is also prohibited within 100 metres of certain institutions, such as schools, hospitals and religious institutions, unless the owner has given written consent [3]. Fireworks may not be set off on land belonging to someone else without the owner's prior written consent, and you must keep fire extinguishing equipment ready at the site [2]. The passages do not address the rules for your backyard beyond these requirements.
